snippet.title: The Lavarish Facility: Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist The Lavarish Facility:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3681650/The_Lavarish_Facility/

Watch the official wishlist trailer now to get a glimpse of gameplay in my game :D

Special thanks to Kracka and Trevor for helping me gather clips.

- SOCIALS
Discord | https://www.discord.gg/j5TNx98tgf
Twitter | https://x.com/FrizzDeveloper
Tiktok | https://www.tiktok.com/@frizzdeveloper

LAVARISH FAQ:
Q - Is The Game On Roblox?
A - Nope, it will be on steam (link above)

Q - When does the game come out?
A - Planned release for sometime during 2025, but things can change

Q - What can I play the game on when it comes out?
A - Currently PC is only supported, but if the game does well, i'll work on a console port for both Playstation and Xbox, I don't know about nintendo tho
